coverage.note: Working book plus archive, deduplicated by key. The archive exists because the book used to delete everything beyond the newest 400 outright.

byOutcome.definition: closed with a positive R, including setups that timed out while ahead

winRates.note: These differ because a setup can time out slightly positive without ever reaching a target. Both are shown; quoting only the higher one would overstate the hit rate.

episodes.note: Republications of the same move collapsed to one observation. This is the independent unit.

verdict: 0.0755R per signal with interval [-0.031, 0.182], which includes zero — the record does not establish an edge in either direction. Collapsed to 103 independent episodes it reads 0.1507R.
